articles.title: 3 Ways Threat Intelligence Makes Life Easier for American SOC Analysts
articles.summary:
October is Cybersecurity Awareness Month, a good time to rethink how SOC analysts detect and investigate threats, draw conclusions from the first three quarters of 2026, and see how exactly your daily workflows could be improved.  One important takeaway is that visibility into your company’s internal environment alone isn’t enough to ensure effective enterprise security […]

articles.title: FBI Suspects Cybersecurity Executive Helped ShinyHunters Run Extortion Website
articles.summary:
Federal investigators suspect an executive at a United States consulting firm helped ShinyHunters operate a website used to pressure hacked companies into paying ransom demands. The allegation raises questions about whether trusted ransomware advisers crossed from helping victims into supporting the criminals demanding payment for stolen data. The suspected website operator has not been publicly […]

articles.title: Hackers Exploit Open Banking Services to Test Stolen Credentials Without Paying a Cent
articles.summary:
Criminals have found a way to use open banking as a low-cost checking service for stolen bank and card details. In a campaign described by Group-IB, fraudsters abused a spend-management platform’s account-linking process to check whether credentials worked and whether linked accounts held funds. The platform did not lose money through stolen funds, but it […]

articles.title: WP2Shell Attack Lets Hackers Create WordPress Admin Accounts and Install Web Shells Without Login
articles.summary:
WP2Shell combines two WordPress Core flaws to move from an unauthenticated request to server-side code execution. It can let an attacker create an administrator account and install a plugin-based web shell. Seqrite’s October 16 analysis lists affected releases, but does not establish widespread live exploitation. The report says the flaws were disclosed in July 2026. […]

articles.title: Hackers Use Generative AI to Build Custom Malware and Bypass Traditional Security Detection
articles.summary:

The shift puts pressure on security tools that mainly depend on known file signatures, while helping ransomware operators move faster from their first foothold to data theft and encryption. articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Exploit Palo Alto VPN Flaw to Bypass MFA and Steal Credentials From VMware Disks
articles.summary:

In one investigated case, attackers reached VMware management systems and stole credentials directly from a domain controller’s virtual disk, avoiding security tools running inside the virtual machine. articles.title: Hackers Hijack OVHcloud GitHub Releases to Distribute Secret-Stealing Malware
articles.summary:
